subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options the can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a9da3d8d4d93db4396d2d39403f90bc04b8168f1fed6d02e0f9b73c00a4c39b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The arrow shifted one place next in next boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029736239ae71d1b484fa93daa7c5443319a86ab6b37e0cf7332827873212486.png] ​

Step II: The images rotated in 90o in anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f270b2177534cbf78244f8d05fb931db3da43cb7de447494425929cd72ae7a8.png] 

So, the final series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8ba708d16528b79b4f9e8f0a4b634877f4fafcbe7eee5209e50bbb0c69cf8b5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
